verdict.rationale: Linear's own docs say users can analyze customer feedback in bulk with Linear Agent. The homepage also claims feedback is automatically turned into issues that are routed, labeled and prioritized, which amounts to in-product AI analysis and suggestions over workspace data. Both are single, thin marketing-level mentions limited to customer feedback and triage. missing for 10: detailed docs on what insights or suggestions Linear Agent generates, coverage of broader workspace data (projects, cycles, velocity), examples of suggestion UX, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: analyze feedback in bulk with Linear Agent
Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.
